verification_note: City clerk official statement of votes cast for the April 2, 2019 general municipal mail ballot election. MAYOR lines: John Suthers 69,771 (72.51 percent), Juliette Parker 11,453, John Pitchford 9,994, Lawrence Joseph Martinez 5,009. Total votes cast for mayor 96,227. Suthers won a majority, so no runoff was held. The document carries a certification statement dated April 12, 2019.

City clerk official statement of votes cast for the May 16, 2023 mayoral runoff mail ballot election. MAYOR lines: Verni Mobolade 71,491 (57.51 percent) and Wayne Williams 52,812 (42.49 percent), total 124,303. The official document prints the first name as Verni; the candidate on the first-round official statement is Yemi Mobolade. The first round on April 4, 2023 (document S23A) gave Yemi Mobolade 32,429 and Wayne Williams 20,908 with no majority. The runoff is the decisive stage; the first round is not recorded separately. The document carries a certification statement.
